title_text: A Saturation-Based Unification Algorithm for Higher-Order Rational Patterns

Inline.Text: Higher-order unification has been shown to be undecidable. Miller discovered the pattern fragment and subsequently showed that higher-order pattern unification is decidable and has most general unifiers. We extend the algorithm to higher-order rational terms (a.k.a. regular Böhm trees, a form of cyclic λ-terms) and show that pattern unification on higher-order rational terms is decidable and has most general unifiers. We prove the soundness and completeness of the algorithm.
